# Speech biomarkers for post-traumatic stress screening

- Autores: Marta Ruiz
- Año: 2024
- Venue: IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
- Cuartil: Q1
- DOI/URL: https://doi.org/10.1000/fixture.2

## Abstract

Post-traumatic stress disorder is underdiagnosed in primary care.
Acoustic features of speech carry markers of trauma-related distress.
We propose a self-supervised speech encoder fine-tuned on clinical recordings.
The encoder reaches an AUC of 0.81 on an external cohort. Speech screening can complement questionnaires.
